title: wg: virtual-clients-01 L508 The exact key-pair derivation is given only in prose
description:
draft-ietf-mls-virtual-clients (virtual-clients-01), Generating Virtual Client Secrets. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-virtual-clients at 65e960d, L508.

Text: "The
`init_key_secret` and `encryption_key_secret` are used with the target
ciphersuite's KEM to derive the corresponding HPKE key pairs."

Problem: The exact key-pair derivation is given only in prose. All emulator clients must produce bit-identical key pairs, and RFC 9420 §7.4 inserts an extra DeriveSecret(…, "node") step for path nodes, so a formula avoids divergence.

Suggested fix: State `KEM.DeriveKeyPair(init_key_secret)` and `KEM.DeriveKeyPair(encryption_key_secret)` explicitly, using the target ciphersuite's KEM.

Severity: low. Verifier: narrow (Reading (b) is a stretch, because the input is already a DeriveSecret output, and KEM.DeriveKeyPair(init_key_secret) is the natural reading. An explicit formula still costs one line and removes doubt. The note about -01 deriving differently is a revision difference, not a defect, and is dropped.)
